question: The Indian Statue of Unity is located near:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Sarovar Dam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Statue of Unity is located near the **Sardar Sarovar Dam** on the Narmada river in the state of Gujarat, India.
 
• It is a colossal statue dedicated to Indian statesman and independence activist **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**.
